sql:
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    ps.ProductSubcategoryName,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName, ps.ProductSubcategoryName
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.ProductCategoryName ORDER BY TotalSalesAmount DESC) = 1
ORDER BY pc.ProductCategoryName
